text:
sam-dx: Heads up — onboarding samples started failing after we published an exports map-only package. Edge builds (Vercel/CF) pick CJS and crash, and TypeScript can't find d.ts.

ivy-sdk: Ugh. Which sample/version?

sam-dx: edge-quickstart @2.2.0. Steps: npm i @redwood/sdk@2.2.0 -> next dev -> call /api/llm -> TypeError: sdk.default is not a function. IDE says no declaration file.

garry-build: Packed the tarball: dist/types missing (build race) and package.json exports only has import/require. Many packagers fall back to require depending on node/bundler.

mira-edge: Reproduced on a fresh Next 13 edge starter. Also saw `Package subpath './auth' is not defined by "exports"` from a deep import in the sample.

ivy-sdk: We tightened exports to lock internals but missed subpath consumers and forgot to include types in files. Bad combo.

sam-dx: Workarounds: pin to 2.1.x or add a webpack/esbuild alias to point at node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm. Not great for first-time users.

garry-build: Short-term patch plan: publish 2.2.1 with: include dist/types in files, add permissive subpath exports for ./auth and ./lib/*, and add an "edge" conditional pointing to dist/edge/index.mjs. Also add an "default" fallback to help older bundlers.

imy-edge: For auth/retry mismatch we saw: CJS wrapper expects sync token provider while ESM uses async provider, leading to repeated retries when wrong bundle lands. We should normalize token providers at runtime with a one-time migration log to avoid retry storms.

ivy-sdk: Agreed. Also add a prepublish npm pack smoke-test in the CI that installs the tarball into a minimal Next/Edge app and builds it under Node 14/16 matrix to catch resolver drift.

qa-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-repo/sdk/issues/1042 with repro, logs, and suggested patch. Labels: release-blocker, edge. Assigned to ivy-sdk + garry-build.

sam-dx: After the patch, update samples to use only public imports and add a lint rule to block deep imports from packages. We'll remove permissive subpath exports in a major release.

ivy-sdk: I'll cut the 2.2.1 patch now. Will include changelog note and a short troubleshooting blurb for Next/Vercel/Cloudflare.
